title: Stable identity, scoped authority
supabiz_proposal: Keep a provider-independent agent principal with separate Consu, ForeFathers and Arkaj memberships. Bind channel identities to it without merging business authority.
measure: Wrong-business actions; identity continuity after model/provider changes

title: Observe without answering every message
supabiz_proposal: Allow authorized quiet capture, then wake on an eligible mention, explicit request or approved workflow. Show listening versus working.
measure: Model turns per 100 messages; missed actionable events; attention load

title: Separate context, requests and actions
supabiz_proposal: Evaluate observation permission, current sender admission, addressing and action authority separately. Earlier conversation is evidence, not a new command.
measure: Unauthorized wake/action rate; useful recall

title: Conversation-specific activation
supabiz_proposal: A manager selects a group, purpose, history window and reply mode. Record activation and membership versions; joining one group grants no unrelated history.
measure: Onboarding time; cross-group retrieval denials

title: Make permissions understandable
supabiz_proposal: Show separate can-read, can-receive, can-reply, can-use-memory and can-change-records cards with concrete examples.
measure: Permission comprehension; accidental grants

title: Preserve the original audience
supabiz_proposal: Store exact business, connector, conversation, thread and audience with each action. Recheck current entitlements; never silently redirect a failed group reply to a private chat.
measure: Wrong audience and stale membership disclosures

title: Bind approval to the actual proposal
supabiz_proposal: Bind approver, business, action digest, record version and expiry. Changing quantity, recipient or amount invalidates approval.
measure: Stale/replayed/wrong-person approvals blocked

title: Durable receipt, result and delivery stages
supabiz_proposal: Persist accepted event, model result and external delivery intent separately. Recover saved results without automatically repeating reasoning or business effects.
measure: Crash recovery correctness; avoidable reruns

title: Make uncertainty visible
supabiz_proposal: After a lost send acknowledgement, show outcome unknown and reconcile via provider receipt/key. Do not infer failure from an absent local response.
measure: Duplicate orders/messages; time in uncertain state

title: Stop the exact worker
supabiz_proposal: Fence a worker generation before replacing or cancelling work. A cancelled async wrapper does not prove a tool subprocess stopped. Explain already committed effects.
measure: Overlapping attempts; orphan operations

title: Bound burst collection and history
supabiz_proposal: Coalesce split staff messages with time, byte and source-count limits; preserve original evidence and expose pending processing. Set caps from measured language/media behavior.
measure: Useful latency; truncation; task recall; retained bytes

title: Use a transactional work ledger
supabiz_proposal: Replace growing whole-conversation checkpoints with durable event and job records, bounded hydration, retention and atomic queue-to-active transitions.
measure: Recovery under injected faults; write amplification; queue age

title: Keep credentials out of model output
supabiz_proposal: Let authorized connectors consume credentials inside the operation boundary. Return redacted receipts, never raw secrets in general model context.
measure: Secret leakage in traces/tool outputs; rotation success

title: Authenticate ingress, then authorize effects
supabiz_proposal: Verify source transport and tenant binding before admission. Signed messages can still contain malicious content; independent policy controls every effect.
measure: Invalid event rejection; injection-triggered actions

title: Quarantine unknown event sources
supabiz_proposal: Unverified events may be inspected in a restricted evidence flow, without the capability to request business changes.
measure: Unverified-to-action escalation attempts

title: Show effective permissions and detect drift
supabiz_proposal: Read back applied server settings and generate capability help from versioned contracts. Block readiness on differences between requested and effective scope.
measure: Configuration mismatch detection; stale guidance incidents

title: Separate voice caller from agent authority
supabiz_proposal: Give each call a scoped capability set; step up identity checks for disclosures and approvals. Voice modality does not grant owner privileges.
measure: Unauthorized disclosure/action rate; useful call resolution

title: Progress should show business truth
supabiz_proposal: Use one compact thread status: captured, assigned, waiting for approval, delivery unknown, verified. Agent finished is not purchase received or task completed.
measure: Manager follow-ups; false completion; time to verified result

title: A2A messages need bounded delegation
supabiz_proposal: Treat a remote agent as an external principal with explicit purpose, data scope, task ID and expiry. Remote assertions never become local approval.
measure: Cross-business leakage; duplicate delegated work

title: Keep communication behind replaceable adapters
supabiz_proposal: Own canonical contacts, evidence, action ledger and exports. Evaluate vendor licensing, retention, regions, India channel availability and real unit economics before adoption.
measure: Provider migration completeness; cost per verified workflow
